# `04-account` — Account Engine

| | |
|---|---|
| **Tier** | T0 |
| **Status** | `in-progress` |

## Purpose

Account identity, lifecycle and the balance-side view of a client: balance, equity, available balance, status, currency, leverage and permissions.

## Depends on

- [`03-ledger`](03-ledger.md) — Double-Entry Ledger

## Depended on by

- [`05-position`](05-position.md) — Position Engine
- [`16-kyc-aml`](16-kyc-aml.md) — KYC / AML / Fraud
- [`19-client-api`](19-client-api.md) — Client API

## Inputs

- ledger
- events

## Outputs

- AccountState
- available balance
- account status transitions

## What gets built

- account lifecycle state machine (pending, active, restricted, frozen, closed)
- balance / available-balance projection over the ledger
- reservations and holds (withdrawal reservation, margin hold)
- per-account leverage and trading permission configuration
- fees and adjustments

## Invariants

These are executed as tests at gate **G4**. A module may not declare an
invariant it does not test.

- INV-030: available balance == balance - reservations - used margin; never negative without an explicit deficit event.
- INV-031: no balance mutation exists without a corresponding ledger transaction.
- INV-032: a frozen or closed account cannot originate new financial effects.

## Test obligations

- deposit, withdrawal reservation, release, fee, adjustment
- freeze and close blocks every mutating path
- reservation double-release is idempotent

## Known failure modes

The things that go wrong in systems like this one. Each should map to a test above.

- balance updated directly instead of via the ledger
- reservation leaked on a failed withdrawal
